blocks.x: Cloud, Edge & Platform for Medical Devices & MedTech — hybrid estates, edge fabric and internal platforms — engineered for reliability and unit cost applied to the medical devices & medtech operating unit of Healthcare & Life Sciences.

MedTech sells outcomes and must prove them: connected devices generate telemetry that feeds service revenue, clinical evidence and regulatory post-market surveillance. The device-to-evidence loop is an engineering product — and EU MDR/CRA raise its bar.

items: Service cost per device unknown; contracts priced on tradition.
Installed base lacks provisioning/OTA; service runs on reactive dispatch and field guesswork.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Edge Computing & Distributed Infrastructure, Platform Engineering & Developer Experience, Hybrid & Multicloud Architecture from the Cloud, Edge & Platform Engineering tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Device provisioning/OTA, Service dispatch, Vigilance reporting) on Achala Forge and Achala Twinverse. Governance inherits the sector frame — EU MDR among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Reliability as product — SLOs, error budgets and incident discipline that engineers actually follow.
Golden paths, paved roads — an internal platform that turns months into days.
Cost and carbon as engineering metrics — unit economics, showback and green compute by design.
